prompt: The evaluation repository asks the agent to "Apply vector database expertise to this task". The evidence packet contains a surprising subgroup result, a stale or weak source field, and uncertainty that must not be converted into unsupported precision. The acceptance boundary is vector-search-systems: Define the retrieval unit, embedding version, metric, normalization, metadata filters, top-k behavior, ANN index parameters, update/delete lifecycle, and reranking contract. The adjacent mongodb-engineering discipline is a routing decoy unless its separate responsibility is actually requested. Resolve environment facts that change the answer, preserve existing contracts and user-owned state, and produce reproducible success plus failure or recovery evidence. A happy path alone is insufficient.

requirements: fixed full-precision vectors and exact reference neighbors plus quantized/reranked candidate outputs
tenant/metadata partitions and shard routing/global top-k fixtures
growth, memory/storage/build and concurrent-query capacity traces
ingestion/upsert/delete/replica freshness streams plus old/new snapshot rollback controls
representative negative, interruption, compatibility, or recovery path

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual vector-search-systems boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (broader=backend-engineering; near-neighbor=mongodb-engineering), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.
Define the retrieval unit, embedding version, metric, normalization, metadata filters, top-k behavior, ANN index parameters, update/delete lifecycle, and reranking contract.
The result must make its consequential assumptions, ownership, and decision sequence explicit and reproducible.
Use labeled relevance cases to measure recall/precision or ranking quality across embedding/index revisions, filters, stale data, multilingual inputs, and latency/memory budgets.

The result must not take the tempting shortcut prohibited by this skill: Do not treat cosine similarity as semantic truth, mix embeddings from incompatible models silently, ignore filter selectivity, or tune top-k without downstream evaluation.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (Vector type/dimension/distance operator plus exact reference query contract; ANN recall@k versus exact with index/search parameters, filters, tenant isolation and latency distributions; Build/storage/memory, concurrency, update/upsert/delete freshness and maintenance evidence; Quantization/capacity/sharding or partitioning plus shadow migration and rollback evidence), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
